description: Deliverable (B): remove the odds/multiplier concept completely from the user-facing prediction/parlay product and from all ranking/payout math. Keep the DB odds and payout columns (NO drop migration); stop requiring, writing, validating, and displaying odds, and remove odds-derived figures (payout, average_odds, net_profit_loss, implied probability). Done bottom-up in the design's safe removal order so the build never breaks mid-way. Independent of FEAT-002; FEAT-003 depends on the post-this-feature BetslipCardView layout. Private bet_tracker (components/props/BetTrackerView.tsx, app/api/bets/route.ts) is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE and left untouched.
steps: Step 1 (display components first): In components/room/BetslipCard.tsx delete the 'Total Odds' hero block (betslip.odds.toFixed(2)x), the implied-probability line and its `impliedProb = Math.round((1/betslip.odds)*100)` computation, and the Payout/Potential block; rework the hero row to show Stake only (keep status); remove the now-unused TrendingUp import if unused. In components/room/MessageRow.tsx (BetslipCardView) delete the 'Multiplier' cell. In components/room/TopBetPanel.tsx delete the 'Multiplier' label + `${bet.odds}x`. In components/parlays/PredictionRow.tsx remove the formatOdds import, the 'Odds' column, and the odds-based P/L (unitResult using decimalOdds) column. In components/parlays/ParlayBetslipCard.tsx remove the computePayout import, the payout return, and the 'Multiplier & Return' block (formatOdds). In components/room/PredictionPickerModal.tsx remove the formatOdds import and the 'Odds' display. In app/(app)/l/[username]/PublicProfileClient.tsx remove the `@ {parlay.odds}` odds line. In app/(app)/leaderboard/LeaderboardClient.tsx remove the 'Avg Odds' column and the average_odds field from its local type. In app/(app)/wallet/WalletClient.tsx remove odds from the betslip summary client type.

Step 2 (client input components): In components/betslip/CreateBetslipModal.tsx delete the 'Total Multiplier' label + odds number Input, the odds useState, `odds: parseFloat(odds)` from the POST payload, and the `!odds` term in the submit disabled guard. In components/parlays/SaveParlayDialog.tsx delete the 'Multiplier' field label + input, its validation messages, and the computePayout payout preview; stop sending odds in the save payload (send null / omit).

Step 3 (API response shapes): In app/api/betslips/feed/route.ts drop odds from the select and returned object. In app/api/rooms/[roomId]/messages/route.ts drop odds from the shared betslip/parlay message payload. In app/api/rooms/[roomId]/top-bet/route.ts drop odds from the payload. In app/api/wallet/route.ts drop odds from the wallet betslip summary projection. In app/api/profiles/[identifier]/route.ts, app/(app)/l/[username]/page.tsx, app/(app)/profile/page.tsx, and app/api/export/bets/route.ts remove the 'average odds' computation and any field that surfaces it. In app/(app)/explore/ExploreClient.tsx drop odds from the mapped parlay card object.

Step 4 (ranking/stats libs + types): In lib/data/leaderboard.ts remove the decimalOdds import, the totalOdds aggregation, the odds field from the paged select, and average_odds from LeaderboardEntry and every pushed row. In lib/parlays/computations.ts, inside computeParlayStats, drop the net_profit_loss computation and the field from the returned object. In lib/types/parlay.ts remove net_profit_loss from the ParlayStats interface. In app/(app)/bets/page.tsx remove the block that renders stats.net_profit_loss (the ±N.Nu P/L figure).

Step 5 (create/validate/grade): In app/api/betslips/route.ts change createBetslipSchema.odds to .optional().nullable() and stop inserting a required odds (insert `odds: data.odds ?? null`). In app/api/betslips/[betslipId]/status/route.ts stop writing payout on grade (remove the `updatePayload.payout = Math.round(stake*odds*100)/100` branch) and drop odds from the fetch select, keeping the concurrency guard (.eq('status','Pending'), handleConflict) and single-grade invariant unchanged. In lib/parlays/validation.ts remove the odds validation branch and the MIN_ODDS/MAX_ODDS constants (odds becomes accepted-but-ignored; do not error if present). Leave app/api/parlays/route.ts as-is (already null-tolerant).

Step 6 (delete leaf functions + tests): In lib/parlays/computations.ts delete computePayout, decimalOdds, and formatOdds (keep computeStreak, computeParlayStats, computeMostCommonSport, computeByLegCount). In lib/parlays/computations.test.ts delete the describe('computePayout') and describe('formatOdds') blocks and their imports, and delete the two net_profit_loss test cases; keep streak/stats tests minus any net_profit_loss/odds assertions. Update or remove any other __tests__/* assertions referencing odds/payout/average_odds/Multiplier so the suite stays green.

Step 7 (residual-reference check): repo-wide grep for '\.odds\b', 'formatOdds', 'computePayout', 'decimalOdds', 'average_odds', 'net_profit_loss' across app/ components/ lib/ and confirm the only remaining hits are the out-of-scope bet_tracker (components/props/BetTrackerView.tsx, app/api/bets/route.ts) and retained DB columns; rely on TypeScript to confirm zero callers of the deleted leaf functions.
acceptance_criteria: No user-facing prediction/parlay surface displays odds, multiplier, implied probability, payout, average odds, or an odds-derived P/L (net_profit_loss).

POST /api/betslips accepts a payload without odds (schema optional/nullable) and never computes payout from odds; grading a betslip no longer writes payout; the single-grade concurrency guard is unchanged.
lib/parlays/computations.ts no longer exports computePayout, decimalOdds, or formatOdds, and ParlayStats no longer has net_profit_loss.
The DB odds and payout columns still exist (no migration added or changed).
Running `npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test` from the worktree root all pass.
verification: From /Users/ayushkumar/development/betroom/.worktrees/experts-leaderboard run `npx tsc --noEmit` (expect no type errors), `npm run lint` (expect clean), `npm run build` (expect success), `npm test` (expect all vitest tests pass).

Run a repo-wide grep for '\.odds\b', 'formatOdds', 'computePayout', 'decimalOdds', 'average_odds', 'net_profit_loss' in app/ components/ lib/ and confirm only the out-of-scope bet_tracker files remain.
findings: Odds/multiplier fully removed from user-facing prediction/parlay surfaces and ranking/payout math, bottom-up per the safe-removal order. KEY NOTES for later steps (esp. FEAT-003 which depends on the post-removal BetslipCardView layout): components/room/MessageRow.tsx BetslipCard type no longer has `odds`; BetslipCardView now renders only Hit rate + Entry cells (no Multiplier). The shared-prediction broadcast type lib/realtime/chat.ts BroadcastBetslipCard dropped `odds`; GET /api/rooms/[roomId]/messages, top-bet, and the POST broadcast card no longer select/emit odds (top-bet now ranks winning parlays by combined_hit_rate instead of odds). lib/parlays/computations.ts no longer exports computePayout/decimalOdds/formatOdds and ParlayStats dropped net_profit_loss (lib/types/parlay.ts updated). lib/parlays/validation.ts: odds is accepted-but-ignored (MIN_ODDS/MAX_ODDS removed). POST /api/betslips schema odds is now optional().nullable() and inserts `odds: data.odds ?? null`; grading (status route) no longer writes payout. Stats surfaces (profile/page.tsx, l/[username]/page.tsx + their clients, /api/profiles/[identifier]) dropped averageOdds/average_odds; LeaderboardClient + lib/data/leaderboard.ts dropped Avg Odds. SaveParlayDialog/CreateBetslipModal dropped the multiplier inputs and stop sending odds (SaveParlayDialog sends odds:null). DB odds/payout columns intentionally retained — NO migration added. OUT OF SCOPE and untouched: components/props/BetTrackerView.tsx and app/api/bets/route.ts (bet_tracker). The only residual odds/payout grep hits are those two files, the already-null-tolerant app/api/parlays/route.ts, retained betslips odds/payout DB-column reads in app/api/betslips/route.ts + lib/queue/handlers.ts (background export CSV, not a UI surface), and the retained DB columns. Verification: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean except two PRE-EXISTING `@/public/hero-optimized.png` module errors (present on base, resolve during `next build`); `npm run lint` 0 errors; `npm run build` compiles + passes TS and completes fully when the main workspace .env.local is provided (worktree lacks env vars so a bare build stops at page-data collection — identical on base); `npm test` matches base exactly (12 pre-existing `server-only`/arena/isr env-only failing files, 1 pre-existing failed test), all 7 odds-related test assertions updated to green.
